item.title: HSBC and Standard Chartered Complete First Swift Tokenized Deposit Deal
item.summary: HSBC and Standard Chartered have completed what the banks described as the first live cross-border transaction involving tokenized deposits between two banks on Swift’s blockchain-based ledger, marking a significant step in efforts to modernize international payments infrastructure. The transaction demonstrated that regulated digital representations of bank deposits can be exchanged across different banking systems.
